name: Snare
notes:
snareTunedSeed is the `snare` instrument, RETUNED toward its reference
(579499__yenus__fat-snare-bottom-ramon, catalogued as snare-freesound-alt)
and expressed purely as CONFIG over the shared source==7 voice — no bespoke
C, no hand-written recipe. Every value below is a live knob in the Synth
tab's VOICE stage.

Measured gap the retune closes (reference vs the previous fat-bottom tuning,
both at native pitch): the old sound was already right in the ATTACK (73%
vs 71% in 100-300 Hz) but its tail ran ~32 dB too hot — the reference is
-74 dB by 400 ms while the synth was still at -41.9 dB — and what remained
was the wrong content: 19% low mush where the reference is 63% WIRES.
So the body pitch rises to the measured 199 Hz, the wire tail dies ~2x
faster, the low noise dies ~3.5x faster, and the wires come up.
The original sound is preserved as snareFatOriginalSeed (snare-lofi / snare-ghost).

core.notes: voice_freq_hz: measured f0 of the reference (was 186)

finish.notes: out_clamp: no output limit (these voices never had one)

layers.notes:
gen1_snare_noise_d: was 7 — the low noise was the tail mush
gen1_snare_noise_m: was 0.56 — less low noise
gen1_snare_tail_d: was 10 — reference is gone by ~400 ms
gen1_snare_tone2: 1.50x f0 — the reference's 2nd mode
gen1_snare_tone_d: body thump: already correct, unchanged
gen1_snare_tone_m: body level unchanged
gen1_snare_tune: brighter wire bands (ref is wire-dominated 2-8 kHz)
gen1_snare_variant: base snare voice
gen1_snare_wire_m: was 0.8 — wires carry the tail
